summary: {person} checks the direction of travel before telling a rider how a detour changes the trip.
realLife: Milwaukee’s summer notice placed Route 18 on an eastbound detour and explained that the timetable allowed extra travel time.
gates: A temporary detour applies in only one direction.
weights: Opposite-direction commutes make a blanket route warning less useful.
inGame: needs: direction-specific detour, revised timetable and rider itinerary.

turns.what: Staff identify the altered boarding point.
turns.pulledBy: The rider travels in the affected direction.

turns.what: Staff check the timetable separately from the detour map.
turns.pulledBy: The rider travels the other way.
turns.writesBack: Record the applicable departure without redirecting the rider.
